settings.heading: Overview
settings.body:
A small footprint, quiet air compressor typically used for floating a vibration isolation table or driving a pneumatic microscope lift. Where a probe station has no compressed air line available, this compressor supplies it at the bench.

Each compressor ships with the connector, tubing and a power cord — a USA three prong plug on the 115 V unit, or a European two prong plug on the 230 V unit.

settings.question: Which electrical type should I order?
settings.answer: Order the 115 V unit for USA mains, which ships with a three prong USA power cord, or the 230 V unit for European mains, which ships with a two prong Euro cord.

settings.question: What is the compressor normally used for?
settings.answer: Most commonly for floating a vibration isolation table, or for driving a pneumatic microscope lift on a probe station.

settings.question: What does the compressor come with?
settings.answer: Each unit ships with the connector, tubing and the power cord for the selected region.

settings.question: Is it quiet enough for a working lab?
settings.answer: Yes. The unit is specified as small footprint and quiet, which is why it is the one we supply for bench-side use alongside probing work.

settings.heading: Building a Complete Probing Station?
settings.body: SemiProbe supplies the vacuum, air and fixturing around your probe system — compressors, pumps, chucks and part holders specified together so the station works as one.

settings.title: Vacuum Pumps
settings.description: Quiet, oil-free diaphragm vacuum pumps for stable platen base fixation.

settings.title: Manual Manipulators
settings.description: X, Y and Z probe positioning across four model series, 5 µm to 0.35 µm.

settings.title: Wafer Chucks
settings.description: Vacuum and thermal chucks engineered for 100 mm to 300 mm wafer hold-down.

settings.title: Probe Arms
settings.description: Individual coaxial, triaxial, Kelvin, and HF probe arms with precision mounts.
